title: Home maintenance
audience: For homeowners and renters who forget the filter until it's a problem.
description: Every job around the home, when it's next due, and what you've spent this year. Mark one done in the app, or tell your AI.
tagline: What's due around the house, and when.
seoTitle: Home maintenance checklist template for ChatGPT
note:
Home maintenance

The jobs that keep your home working live in the app: what's late, what's due this month, and what you've spent this year. Mark one done there and it works out when it's next. Or tell your AI, like "cleaned the gutters today, 900 kr".

## To fix someday
Small repairs with no schedule, one line each.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Home maintenance". It is an app; its data is "Home maintenance.app/data.json", beside the note. Read it with fetch before each change; change it with edit. Jobs are in values.jobs as { id, name, area, every ("3 months", "1 year", "autumn"), last (yyyy-mm-dd), contact, cost }. When I say I did one, add { id, job, date, cost, note } to values.history and set the job's last to that date. Due next: last plus every; a season job is due from its season's start (1 March, 1 June, 1 September, 1 December). Appliances with model, serial and warranty end go in values.appliances, people to call in values.contacts.

asks: Ask which jobs my home needs and when I last did each, then add them.
Cleaned the gutters today, cost 900 kr.

args.new_string:
